title: Effect of Preheating Build Platform on Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Additively Manufactured 316L Stainless Steel

blocks.text: Two sets of specimens were fabricated under argon shielding gas, without and with preheating the build platform to 150 °C. Specimen geometry is shown in Figure 1. For better tracking each set of specimens in the following context, specimens fabricated without preheating the build platform, and the ones fabricated with preheating the build platform to 150 °C are designated by NP and P150, respectively.
Preheating the build platform to 150 °C increased the ductility of material by 14%.
